paper.title: Analysis of Short-Term Responses to Hypoxia During Stirred-Tank Fermentation in Aspergillus oryzae
paper.authors: Araki S, Susukida S, Miyazawa K, Kumagai T, Tokashiki J, Abe K
paper.association_evidence: Data availability: 'The raw RNA-seq data are deposited in the DDBJ Sequence Read Archive under Bioproject ID PRJDB37930.'

study_summary.objective: Characterise the first hours (<= 6 h) of the A. oryzae response to hypoxia in an industrial-style stirred-tank bioreactor.
study_summary.experimental_design: Fed-batch 4 L bioreactor cultures of WT, the hyphal-dispersion mutant AGΔ-GAGΔ and its ΔaoxA derivative (all with PglaA142-cutL1), kept at 10% dissolved oxygen (control) or let fall to <=1% (hypoxia); sampled at baseline (B3h) and 0, 1, 3, 6 h after onset.
study_summary.main_finding: Hypoxia transiently repressed respiratory complexes I-III and immediately induced complex IV, the alternative oxidase gene and glycolysis, keeping ATP stable; a transient ROS burst was prolonged when aoxA was deleted.

genotype_WT.note: the paper's control strain 'WT-cutL1': wild type for the cell-wall and aoxA genes, but it carries the cutL1 expression construct

cutL1 (AO090005000029) is expressed from the glaA142 promoter in all three strains (WT-cutL1, AG-GAG-cutL1, AG-GAG-AOXA-cutL1); the lineage comes from Miyazawa K, Yoshimi A, Zhang S, Sano M, Nakayama M, Gomi K, Abe K (2016) Biosci Biotechnol Biochem 80(9):1853-1863, doi 10.1080/09168451.2016.1209968, where cutL1 was transformed into the wild type and an alpha-1,3-glucan-synthase-deficient mutant. Identified by the curator, not described in the Journal of Fungi paper's main text.
cutL1 is an endogenous A. oryzae cutinase gene overexpressed from a construct

PglaA142 as read by the curator from the lineage paper (Miyazawa et al. 2016); the promoter is not named in that paper's abstract, in the SRA/ENA metadata or in the Journal of Fungi main text, and the lineage paper's full text was not available to re-check it.

notes: Resolves fields left unresolved in metadata/conditions.tsv: 'ctrl' = DO maintained at 10%, 'hypo' = DO allowed to fall to <=1%, B3h = baseline after 3 h at 10% DO, 'AOXA' = deletion of the alternative oxidase gene aoxA in the AGΔ-GAGΔ background; 'AG-GAG' = alpha-1,3-glucan synthase + galactosaminogalactan synthase gene knockout.

All 85 runs carry a cutL1 expression construct (curator-identified 2026-10-27): cutL1 (AO090005000029), the A. oryzae cutinase CutL1, is expressed from the glaA142 promoter in WT-cutL1, AG-GAG-cutL1 and AG-GAG-AOXA-cutL1. Lineage paper: Miyazawa K, Yoshimi A, Zhang S, Sano M, Nakayama M, Gomi K, Abe K (2016) Biosci Biotechnol Biochem 80(9):1853-1863, doi 10.1080/09168451.2016.1209968. The promoter is the curator's reading of that paper (not in its abstract or the SRA metadata). Consequence: the expression of this gene here (median ~17,000 TPM, against ~9 TPM in the other studies) is construct-driven and says nothing about its native regulation.

Curated strain labels carry the suffix _cutL (NS4_cutL, AG-GAG_cutL, AG-GAG-AOXA_cutL) because every condition expresses the cutL1 construct (user decision 2026-11-04); the parent strain stays in the strain_* tags.
